4. Size and Scale
Reference is made to the "Project Boundary Map" (appendix C), which illustrates the shape of the project. It can best be described as an elongated rectangle with a land area of approximately 103.9 acres. Its dimensions are roughly 5,000 feet by 1,000 feet, with the long side following a gentle curve of the River. This area represents less than 3 percent of the total land surface area of the City; however, it constitutes about 20 percent of the City's river frontage (exclusive of the western shore area). The boundaries of the project can be followed on the Project Boundary Map. They are as follows:
Beginning at the point of intersection of the eastern right-ofway line of Green Street and the northern right-of-way line of Woodbine Street, thence in a southerly direction along the eastern right-of-way line of Green Street to the point of intersection of said line and the southern right-of-way line of Cumberland Street; thence in a westerly direction along the southern right-of-way line of Cumberland Street to the point of intersection of said line and the eastern low-water line of the Susquehanna River; thence in a northerly direction along the eastern low-water line of the Susquehanna River to the point of intersection of said line and the northern right-of-way line of Woodbine Street extended; thence in a easterly direction along the northern right-of-way line of Woodbine Street to the point of intersection of said line and the eastern right-of-way line of Green Street, the point of Beginning.
